svg.title: Parent LEDs, buzzer, LCD, GPS and microSD
svg.desc: ESP32-C5 WiFi6 N32R8 • GPIO/header mapping from supplied pinout and Waveshare schematic.
svg.text: Parent LEDs, buzzer, LCD, GPS and microSD
ESP32-C5 WiFi6 N32R8 • GPIO/header mapping from supplied pinout and Waveshare schematic.
LEDs: GPIO0 increasing / GPIO1 decreasing / GPIO8 steady. Buzzer PWM: GPIO9.
LCD: GPIO4 SDA / GPIO5 SCL. GPS: GPIO10 RX (UART0). GPS RX is unused; tx_pin = -1.
Parent RS-485: GPIO11 TX / GPIO3 RX / GPIO7 RTS. microSD: SCK23 / MOSI24 / MISO2 / CS25.
One resistor per LED. Cathode K = flat edge / short lead.
BZ1: 5 V passive magnetic buzzer, 20 mA max; D1 band to +5 V.
Q1 lead order: check your part datasheet. No GPIO load drive.
Two bidirectional BSS138 channels. LV = 3.3 V; HV = 5 V; all grounds joined.
Shifter: LV supply to parent 3V3; HV supply to regulated +5 V; GND to common ground.
Each MOSFET: gate to 3.3 V; source to LV signal; drain to matching HV signal.
LCD VCC to +5 V; GND to common ground. Address 0x27 assumed; verify backpack and contrast.
Pull-ups shown are TOTAL per line/side: reuse fitted resistors, do not blindly add parallel sets.
4 Grove GPS Air530 — receive-only UART0 at 9600 baud
GPS RX: leave disconnected. Use connector signal labels; check orientation rather than cable color.
5 microSD over SPI2 — 3.3 V logic and card supply
3V3 to card VDD (pin 4); GND to VSS (pin 6). Add 100 nF + 10 µF near the socket.
10 kΩ pull-ups to 3.3 V: CS, CMD, DAT0, DAT1 (pin 8), DAT2 (pin 1); no pull-up on CLK.
Use a native 3.3 V SPI breakout. HW-125 supply / regulator / level-shifter variant must be checked.
Pull-ups may already be fitted. Card contact numbers are not the adapter header order.
Parent via documented USB input. External regulated +5 V feeds LCD and buzzer; join its GND to parent GND.
Leave parent P1.14 / 5V unconnected with this external load supply. Keep +5 V off ESP32 GPIOs.
Add 100 nF across VCC/GND at GPS and LCD, plus 10 µF across the local +5 V/GND load rail.
Use efficient red/green/amber LEDs (~2–3 mA with 470 Ω). Verify parent 3V3 regulator headroom for GPS.
Example config enables all five peripherals and remaps parent bus RX to GPIO3. Default config stays unchanged.
Avoid GPIO6 (battery ADC), GPIO15 (PSRAM), GPIO27 (RGB), GPIO28 (BOOT), GPIO12 (USB-UART TX).
Logical wiring • connectors not drawn to physical pin order • see docs/wiring.md
